an8.30:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Bhaggesu viharati Suṃsumāragire Bhesakaḷāvane Migadāye.
an8.30:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Anuruddho Cetīsu viharati Pācīnavaṃsadāye.
an8.30:1.3: Atha kho āyasmato Anuruddhassa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
an8.30:1.10: paññavato ayaṃ dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo duppaññassā' ti. 2.
an8.30:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmato Anuruddhassa cetasā ceto parivitakkam aññāya seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Bhaggesu Suṃsumāragire Bhesakaḷāvane Migadāye antarahito Cetīsu Pācīnavaṃsadāye āyasmato Anuruddhassa sammukhe pāturahosi:
an8.30:2.3: Āyasmā pi kho Anuruddho Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an8.30:2.4: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:-- 3.
an8.30:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ Anuruddha satta mahāpurisavitakke vitakkesi:
an8.30:3.9: paññavato ayaṃ dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo duppaññassā ti.
an8.30:3.10: Tena hi tvaṃ Anuruddha imam pi aṭṭhamaṃ mahāpurisavitakkaṃ vitakkehi:
an8.30:3.11: nippapañcārāmassāyaṃ dhammo nippapañcaratino, nāyaṃ dhammo papañcārāmassa papañcaratino ti. 4.
an8.30:4.1: Yato kho tvaṃ Anuruddha ime aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi, tato tvaṃ Anuruddha, yāva-d-eva ākaṅkhissasi, vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharissasi. 5.
an8.30:5.1: Yato kho tvaṃ Anuruddha ime aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi, tato tvaṃ Anuruddha, yāva-d-eva ākaṅkhissasi, vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharissasi. 6.
an8.30:6.1: Yato kho tvaṃ Anuruddha ime aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi, tato tvaṃ Anuruddha, yāva-d-eva ākaṅkhissasi, pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca viharissasi sato ca sampajāno, sukhañ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedissasi, yan taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti ‘upekhako satimā sukhavihārī' ti, tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharissasi. 7.
an8.30:7.1: Yato kho tvaṃ Anuruddha ime aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi, tato tvaṃ Anuruddha, yāva-d-eva ākaṅkhissasi, sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubb' eva somanassadomanassānaṃ aṭṭhaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharissasi. 8.
an8.30:8.1: Yato kho tvaṃ Anuruddha ime ca aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi imesañ ca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, tato tuyhaṃ Anuruddha seyyathā pi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā nānārattānaṃ dussānaṃ dussakaraṇḍako pūro,
an8.30:8.2: evam eva te paṃsukūlacīvaraṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa. 9.
an8.30:9.1: Yato kho tvaṃ Anuruddha ime ca aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi imesañ ca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, tato tuyhaṃ Anuruddha seyyathā pi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā sālīnaṃ odano vicitakāḷako anekasūpo anekavyañjano, evam
an8.30:9.2: eva te piṇḍiyālopabhojanaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa. 10.
an8.30:10.1: Yato kho tvaṃ Anuruddha ime ca aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi imesañ ca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, tato tuyhaṃ Anuruddha seyyathā pi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā kūṭāgāraṃ ullittāvalittaṃ nivātaṃ phusitaggaḷaṃ pihitavātapānaṃ,
an8.30:10.2: evam eva te rukkhamūlasenāsanaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa. 11.
an8.30:11.1: Yato kho tvaṃ Anuruddha ime ca aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi imesañ ca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, tato tuyhaṃ Anuruddha seyyathā pi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā pallaṅko gonakatthato paṭikatthato paṭalikatthato kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sa-uttaracchado ubhato lohitakūpadhāno, evam
an8.30:11.2: eva te tiṇasantharakasayanāsanaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa. 12.
an8.30:12.1: Yato kho tvaṃ Anuruddha ime ca aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi imesañ ca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, tato tuyhaṃ Anuruddha seyyathā pi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā nānābhesajjāni, seyyathīdaṃ sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phānitaṃ,
an8.30:12.2: evam eva te pūtimuttabhesajjaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa. 13.
an8.30:12.3: Tena hi tvaṃ Anuruddha āyatikam pi vassāvāsaṃ idh' eva Cetīsu Pācīnavaṃsadāye vihareyyāsī ti.
an8.30:12.4: Evaṃ bhante ti kho āyasmā Anuruddho Bhagavato paccassosi.
an8.30:13.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Cetīsu Pācīnavaṃsadāye antarahito Bhaggesu Suṃsumāragire Bhesakaḷāvane Migadāye pāturahosi.
an8.30:13.4: Aṭṭha vo bhikkhave mahāpurisavitakke desessāmi, taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī ti. Evam bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ. Bhagavā etad avoca:--
an8.30:13.6: Appicchassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo mahicchassa;
an8.30:13.7: santuṭṭhassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo asantuṭṭhassa;
an8.30:13.8: pavivittassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo saṅgaṇikārāmassa;
an8.30:13.9: āraddhaviriyassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo kusītassa;
an8.30:13.10: upaṭṭhitasatissāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo muṭṭhassatissa;
an8.30:13.11: samāhitassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo asamāhitassa;
an8.30:13.12: paññavato ayaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo duppaññassa;
an8.30:13.13: nippapañcārāmassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo nippapañcaratino, nāyaṃ dhammo papañcārāmassa papañcaratino. 16.
an8.30:14.1: Appicchassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo mahicchassā ti
an8.30:14.2: iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? 17.
an8.30:14.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu appiccho samāno ‘appiccho ti maṃ jāneyyun' ti na icchati, santuṭṭho samāno ‘santuṭṭho ti maṃ jāneyyun' ti na icchati, pavivitto samāno ‘pavivitto ti maṃ jāneyyun' ti na icchati, āraddhaviriyo samāno ‘āraddhaviriyo ti maṃ jāneyyun' ti na icchati, upaṭṭhitasati samāno ‘upaṭṭhitasatī ti maṃ jāneyyun ti na icchati, samāhito samāno ‘samāhito ti maṃ jāneyyun' ti na icchati, paññavā samāno ‘paññavā ti maṃ jāneyyun' ti na icchati, nippapañcārāmo samāno ‘nippapañcārāmo ti maṃ jāneyyun' ti na icchati.
an8.30:14.4: Appicchassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo mahicchassā ti
an8.30:14.5: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 18.
an8.30:15.1: Santuṭṭhassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo asantuṭṭhassā ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? 19.
an8.30:15.3: Santuṭṭhassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo asantuṭṭhassā ti
an8.30:15.4: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 20.
an8.30:16.1: Pavivittassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo saṅgaṇikārāmassā ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? 21.
an8.30:16.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato bhavanti upasaṅkamitāro bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo rājāno rājamahāmattā titthiyā titthiyasāvakā.
an8.30:16.3: Tatra bhikkhu vivekaninnena cittena vivekapoṇena vivekapabbhārena vivekaṭṭhena nekkhammābhiratena aññadatthu uyyojanikapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ yeva kathaṃ kattā hoti.
an8.30:16.4: Pavivittassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo saṅgaṇikārāmassā ti
an8.30:16.5: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 22.
an8.30:17.1: Āraddhaviriyassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo kusītassā ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? 23.
an8.30:17.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an8.30:17.3: Āraddhaviriyassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo kusītassā ti
an8.30:17.4: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 24.
an8.30:18.1: Upaṭṭhitasatissāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo muṭṭhassatissā ti
an8.30:18.2: iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? 25.
an8.30:18.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatam pi cirabhāsitam pi saritā anussaritā.
an8.30:18.4: Upaṭṭhitasatissāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo muṭṭhassatissā ti
an8.30:18.5: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 26.
an8.30:19.1: Samāhitassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo asamāhitassā ti
an8.30:19.2: iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? 27.
an8.30:19.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an8.30:19.4: Samāhitassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo asamāhitassā ti
an8.30:19.5: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 28.
an8.30:20.1: Paññavato ayaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo duppaññassā ti
an8.30:20.2: iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ c' etaṃ paticca vuttaṃ? 29.
an8.30:20.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
an8.30:20.4: Paññavato ayaṃ bhikkhave dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo duppaññassā ti
an8.30:20.5: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 30.
an8.30:21.1: Nippapañcārāmassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo nippapañcaratino, nāyaṃ dhammo papañcārāmassa papañcaratino ti
an8.30:21.2: iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? 31.
an8.30:21.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno papañcanirodhe cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
an8.30:21.4: Nippapañcārāmassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo nippapañcaratino, nāyaṃ dhammo papañcārāmassa papañcaratino ti
an8.30:21.5: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttan ti. 32.
an8.30:22.1: Atha kho āyasmā Anuruddho āyatikam pi vassāvāsaṃ tatth' eva Cetīsu Pācīnavaṃsadāye vihāsi.
an8.30:22.2: Atha kho āyasmā Anuruddho eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirass' eva yass' atthāya kulaputtā sammad-eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
an8.30:22.3: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā' ti abbhaññāsi,
an8.30:22.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā Anuruddho arahataṃ ahosi.
an8.30:22.5: Atha kho āyasmā Anuruddho arahattappatto tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi:
an8.30:26.4: Anuruddhena te dasā ti. 1. Aṭṭh' imāni
